correctness.rationale: The descending-gap recursion explicitly handles the two simultaneous exceptional sources and its forbidden-channel cases, and the induction determines \(u_d,v_d\) for all \(n\ge5\). The monotonicity lemma and generator-by-generator Bellman inequality exclude all gap-increasing shortcuts, so the formula is the true pair distance. Four critical \(x\) phases reduce the global diameter to four exact residue substitutions; the parity table gives the sharp maximum. Independent reverse pair-BFS checked 287,970 pair distances for \(5\le n\le120\), including boundary \(n=5\) and both parities. Finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Pair synchronizing length is the minimal word needed to eliminate uncertainty between two states, a standard invariant distinct from a full reset threshold. Every labeled pair distance is classified in O(1) symbolic time across infinitely many n for a rank-\(n-2\) idempotent driven by one common input; the sharp worst-pair quadratic constant and parity split are non-obvious. This is neither a parameter renaming of one-merge Černý nor a finite enumeration slice, because both independent contractions operate simultaneously.
